extracted.intended_audience: journalists, stakeholders, and the general public seeking EBRD news, events, and media contact information
extracted.subtask_description: Webpage listing EBRD news and events with UI controls to filter and browse items (by location, sector, type, date) and contact information for media enquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locations (filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a long list of countries and regional option to restrict news/events to a specific geography. Listed entries include: Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Benin, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Côte d’Ivoire, Egypt, Estonia, Georgia, Greece, Hungary, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kenya, Kosovo, Kyrgyz Republic, Latvia, Lebanon, Lithuania, Moldova, Mongolia, Montenegro, Morocco, Nigeria, North Macedonia, Poland, Regional, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovak Republic, Slovenia, Tajikistan, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Türkiye, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, West Bank and Gaza.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sectors (filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows filtering news/events by sector. Listed sectors: Energy, Equity, Equity Funds, Financial Institutions, Food and Agribusiness, Legal Reform, Manufacturing and Services, Municipal Infrastructure, Natural Resources, Nuclear Safety, Real Estate, Telecommunications Media and Technology, Transport.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page Type (filter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows selecting the kind of content to view. Options shown: News, Video, Events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter by Date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date-based filtering options: All dates, This Month, This year, Custom date range. Custom date range has From and To fields and controls to Reset Filter, Cancel, and Apply Filter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sort order
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toggle for ordering results chronologically; page shows options 'Newest first' and 'Oldest first' to control sorting of listed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: View style
rubrics_metrics.guidance: UI control to change presentation of results between 'Cards' and 'List' layouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contacts guidance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction to contact the EBRD Communications Department for interview requests, images, video b-roll or other enquiries; serves as guidance for journalists and media professionals seeking assets or interviews.
